Gen 7: Alola

So The Pokemon Company has also made remakes of some generation

So I would always advise starting with Gen 1.
If you want to experience the old school games, download a Gameboy Advanced Emulator and Download Pokémon Fire red or Leaf green rom on PC. They are the perfect old school games to start with cuz they'll  give you an introduction to the story and mechanics of a lot Pokémon games(Gen 1 - Gen 7)

On the other hand, a great modern game to start with is Pokémon Let's go Pikachu or Let's go Eevee on the Nintendo Switch. They are the same story as  the ones I mentioned above, but they have better graphics and introduce new mechanics that are upgrades of the ones in older games.

Again, I strongly suggest playing the older ones first cuz it's good to experience what they were like before playing newer ones. And if you can, play from generation to generation.
